snippet.title: Chompy Party | Official Fangame Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello Everyone! Welcome to Chompy Party

Hungry? Your friends and enemies are on the menu!

Welcome to Chompy Party! A free online multiplayer fan game set in the world of Skylanders, where you can play as the beloved (or feared) Skylanders Chompy.

WAVES MODE
Face off against your own kind as waves of Chompies come at you, one after another. Survive to the end! Don't worry, as a Chompy, getting absorbed by the earth just means you come back repurposed and replenished. Waves run from 1 to 10... but things get really interesting after that.

ONLINE PvP
Face off against your own kind... again... in online PVP. Bite and chomp until It's done.

Chompy Party and Behavior Hack Studios are not associated with or endorsed by Activision Publishing, and this game is free and non-commercial. Assets were extracted from Skylanders using community-made tools; all game code was written by our team and not taken from any other game. See the in-game credits for full details.

GameJolt Page:

https://gamejolt.com/games/ChompyParty/1091049

For more information, Join the Discord!
https://discord.com/invite/AqPhVkYyYz
